page.overview:
Who is Fraizer?

Professor Fraizer is a solar energy scientist who appears in the 1974 James Bond film The Man with the Golden Gun. He was portrayed by Gerald James.

He is seen on the meeting with M, Q, James Bond, and Hip on the wreckage of the liner Queen Elizabeth. He was there to talk with Gibson and check out his invention the Solex Agitator. But unfortunately the invention was stolen and Gibson was killed.
